authorization: User explicitly resumed research in current conversation; CPU only; no further approval required within stated boundaries
post_deadline_allowed: Existing-evidence review and handoff/report writing only; no method development or experiment

data_contract.metric: raw inner product end to end; query normalization permitted inside router only
data_contract.base_and_graph: Frozen current formal base and original directed NSG, checksums must match P0
data_contract.partition_graph: Only partition input is undirected, symmetrized original NSG; no modification to search graph
data_contract.qgt: Independent 5K QGT exact top-100, existing raw QGT hubs allowed

fit.purpose: Region, portal, router and paired Fast fit

validation.performance_allowed_after: Relevant upstream gates; P6 stability after P5 freeze candidate

data_contract.paired_fast: Rebuild prototype using the same 20K fit rows and raw QGT hubs; old 30K prototypes forbidden as new-method input
data_contract.old_fast30k: Optional stronger reference only, distinctly labelled and excluded from paired20K training chain

p2_preregistered.partition: METIS v5.2.1 64-bit indices, graph structure only
p2_preregistered.geometry_router: Normalized per-region query image from fit20K; dot-product scores, softmax temperature 1.0
p2_preregistered.geometric_region_probability: softmax over fixed 64 region scores; choose top4 with region ID tie break; renormalize selected probabilities for capacity allocation

comparisons.route: true GT10 region fractions, train diagnostic only

p2_preregistered.fast_control: Paired Fast20K same graph/query order/threads; retain primary Fast first entry; preserve old default Fast path
p2_preregistered.trace_query_ids: Preselect before performance results, deterministic pilot row IDs; bounded small sample
p2_preregistered.mechanism_gate: Per s-target: repeatable queue-mechanism gain, or oracle potential with a localized prediction/portal bottleneck. No invented numeric P2 threshold; P5/P6 thresholds are unchanged.
p2_preregistered.no_oracle_benefit_action: Stop current configuration before building a larger model; inspect competition trace only if needed to distinguish equivalent queues or implementation defects
p2_preregistered.oracle_positive_prediction_negative_acti: Decompose prediction/portal loss; at most one representation or partition revision, within overall two mechanism revisions per version

search_contract.capacity: L_shared + sum L_region = L_total exactly; shared floor(0.25*L), regional residual distributed with minimum4 then largest remainder, regionID tie
search_contract.scheduler: Weighted round robin across queues; every retained candidate expanded before termination
search_contract.routing_seeds: Paired Fast first entry retained; graph default entry seeds shared queue as explicit exception; duplicate entry first ownership wins
search_contract.cross_region_edges: Always traversable; no filtering by active region
search_contract.visited: One global visited structure; each base node computed once per query
search_contract.results: One independent global top-K collector in both unified and regional controls
search_contract.api: Real router and search have no GT input; oracle lives in evaluation adapter only
search_contract.top_m: New path consumes all entry IDs, sorted HNSW return order and dedup recorded; legacy search_new mode2 three-entry cap must not be reused for top-m claims

measurement.plain: Batch wall for one method, preallocated per-thread workspace and output buffers
measurement.count: Independent run with routing/graph/total NDC; same result IDs as plain required
measurement.trace: Independent bounded run; same result IDs as plain; GT linked afterward
measurement.pair_rotation: Run order is written before timing; per-pair AB/BA repeated as registered, no selective reruns
measurement.warmup: Fixed complete warm-up batch before each measured invocation; count and trace excluded from timings
measurement.cache: Label warm-cache with fixed warmup; graph loading excluded from online batch wall and reported offline
measurement.not_valid: Do not derive batch QPS from sum or mean of multithread per-query latencies

P0.gate: Input identity/contract checks pass; exploratory/diagnostic/formal data and heldout access gates explicit; dependency readiness is insufficient

tests: trace reconstructs discovery/admission/eviction/expansion with GT joined after
P1.gate: All correctness and measurement checks pass; implementation or timing failure must be repaired and reverified before algorithm judgment

artifacts: five queue comparisons on pilot K10 L64/128
P2.gate: Repeatable mechanism gain OR oracle potential with localized bottleneck; no numeric threshold added to plan
P2.forbidden: Do not build full hierarchy or learned model before mechanism gate

artifacts: lambda1 and lambda0 graph+GT partition controls
two deterministic accepted descent move rounds
P3.gate: Graph+GT partition improves over graph-only and gain passes through actual search

P4.gate: Predicted router retains mechanism gain at acceptable total wall cost

P5.gate: Both datasets meet substantial-performance screen at two adjacent anchors; this is development evidence, not confirmation

P6.gate: Stable substantial gains on both datasets with causal controls; report each build separately; only after PASS freeze method and permit held-out

artifacts: frozen heldout10K x3 timing per build
P7.gate: Replicate main conclusions, otherwise narrow/retract claim; never tune on held-out

P8.gate: Each paper claim tied to valid evidence; submission acceptance not promised

p5_p6_p7_statistics.multiplicity: Bonferroni 2 datasets x3 anchors x2 benefit families
p5_p6_p7_statistics.matching: Measured points only; interpolate only for plots; redo cost matching and best feasible selection inside each bootstrap
p5_p6_p7_statistics.required_per_dataset: At least two adjacent anchors satisfy the same family: matched Recall average QPS>=+10%, OR matched QPS mean Recall@10>=+1pp; corrected CI supports positive benefit

failure_actions.correctness_or_timing_failure: Repair within same protocol, rerun affected checks; do not call algorithm failure
failure_actions.uniform_regional_equivalent: Inspect competition trace; without support close candidate-protection branch
failure_actions.routing_cost_erases_recall: One semantics-preserving implementation optimization; failure after that denies online implementation
failure_actions.single_dataset_only: Analyze applicability, no universal claim or dataset cherry-picking
failure_actions.connectivity_bottleneck_with_correct_reg: May propose separate sparse auxiliary-graph version, retain NSG, max4 edges per portal, no-edge/geometric/target controls and rerun P1-P7
failure_actions.validation_heldout_failure: Freeze negative result, do not tune on heldout
failure_actions.deadline: Stop registered research jobs, keep partials INCOMPLETE; long-term goal remains unfinished

report_contract.title: 实验总结
report_contract.first_paragraph: 3-5 sentences about actual overnight stage/findings/performance evidence/incomplete work, around150 Chinese characters
